name: comfyui_mcp
summary: Outbound connector mirroring third_party/blender_mcp.py shape but pointing at a locally running ComfyUI HTTP API (default http://localhost:8188). Submits workflow templates, polls history, downloads renders into studio/assets/_bakes/<prompt_id>/. Stdlib urllib only — no requests dep. Gracefully degrades when ComfyUI is not running (connect=False, send returns skipped result, never hangs).
engine_pattern: ThirdPartyConnector subclass. HTTP/JSON via urllib. connect() probes GET /system_stats with 2s timeout (cached per instance). Same crystal-id anchoring + send-log pattern as Blender/DeepSeek/Stripe MCP connectors. Every successful submit_workflow → inference_logger.log(tier='comfyui', model='comfyui', scope='comfyui_submit_workflow').

routing_connections.substrate_writes: studio/assets/_bakes/<prompt_id>/<filename> + send log entries + crystal chain records

closes_the_2d_loop: Pinterest harvest → SVG/seed assets → workflow_generator --target comfyui (.json graph) → comfyui_mcp.submit_workflow(template, inputs) → poll get_history → download_output (lands in _bakes/) → crystal-anchored in inference chain. Claude can drive batch image/video generation end-to-end from natural-language cards.
guarantees: Graceful degradation — when ComfyUI :8188 unreachable, connect=False and send returns skipped SendResult without hanging (2s probe timeout)
Same connector shape as Blender/DeepSeek/Stripe MCP — uniform third_party pattern
Every submit_workflow logged via send_log + crystal-chain (searchable by prompt_id + template_name)
Stdlib urllib only — no requests dep, no SDK
usage_example:
from third_party.comfyui_mcp import ComfyUIMCPConnector
c = ComfyUIMCPConnector()
if c.connect():
    r = c.send('submit_workflow', json.dumps({'template_name': 'sdxl_basic', 'inputs': {'SEED': 1234, 'PROMPT': 'a stained glass cat'}}))
    print(r.metadata['prompt_id'])
    # later:
    c.send('download_output', json.dumps({'prompt_id': pid, 'node_id': '9', 'filename': 'ComfyUI_00001_.png'}))
